scanner_output: bandit: [B608:hardcoded_sql_expressions] Possible SQL injection vector through string-based query construction. (app/db.py:5, severity: medium)

findings.title: SQL injection via string formatting in query construction
findings.evidence: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '%s'" % user_id
findings.fix: Parametreli sorgu kullan: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)). Kullanıcı girdisini asla sorgu dizgisine birleştirme.

summary: get_user_by_id fonksiyonu user_id'yi doğrudan SQL dizgisine birleştiriyor; parametreli sorguyla düzeltilmeli.
